source: Seeded from mathematics/y2 lesson 75 (Printable pattern sheet)
intro: Lesson 75: Shape patterns with turns. To understand how to make and continue patterns of shapes and turns

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Rule: quarter turn clockwise each time.

questions.model: Teacher circles the repeating part: star, moon.

questions.q: What turn takes up to down?
Continue each pattern on the sheet for 3 more.
Make a pattern with a quarter turn rule.
questions.a: For example up, right, down, left

questions.q: What is the 10th arrow in up, right, down, left?
questions.a: right (the pattern repeats every 4: 9th up, 10th right)
Find the rule, then use it.
